reason: Replace the blanket neutral-50 fallback and single selected maximum with individual contextual ratings for every accepted canonical answer.
questionWordingAndMembership: Unchanged. IDs, scopes, aliases, date slots, epoch and rotation preserved.

method.method: Each canonical answer reviewed in its question context. Rounded editorial estimates and ties reflect approximate familiarity, not measured player-popularity percentages.
method.coverage: Every answer has an explicit score. No default 50, random jitter, interpolation by array order or scores copied across unrelated questions.

bands.40-59: Less immediate but readily recognised choices
bands.95-100: Least immediate valid choices in this list

method.ties: Similarly immediate answers can share scores, including 100.

examples.context: Milan is 40 among Olympic host cities; Mario is 1 among video games/hat-wearing characters; Superman is 1 and Frozone 80 among film superheroes.

preservation: Old full captures keep original answer points, completed and zero results, deadlines and first-completion locks. Same IDs do not cause score replacement. No model, SQL, scoring formula, timer, layout or account schema change.
limits: Editorial familiarity judgments, not measured player-popularity percentages.
Rounded scores and ties indicate approximate judgments; no claim of a statistically calibrated ranking.

validation.requiredChecks: npm test: all selected checks passed.
validation.content: All 6,402 canonical names and aliases match; explicit assignment fingerprints validate complete review; all 240 questions have at least 14 distinct ratings and four distinct ratings strictly between 50 and 100.
validation.preservation: Question IDs/prompts/scopes/topics/date slots, answer membership and aliases equal revision 12. Current versus captured matching and score calculation pass disposable PostgreSQL parity checks.
validation.browser: Full Daily/Unlimited flows and saved rounds pass at mobile and desktop widths. At 390 and 1440px, actual submissions render 65, 70, 80, 90 and two distinct 100-point answers; old same-ID captures retain 50/100 and pending Daily deadlines/scores.
validation.static: Production build, shipped reference/syntax, content report and legal checks passed.
